description:
Upgrade your truck with OEDRO all-weather floor mats designed for maximum durability, protection, and style. Specially designed for 2022–2026 Nissan Frontier Crew Cab models with under-seat storage, these liners deliver full interior coverage against mud, water, snow, and daily mess. Crafted from high-strength, flexible TPE material, they combine long-lasting toughness with a clean OEM-like fit. The raised edges and anti-slip backing ensure spill containment and stable placement, while the easy-clean surface makes maintenance effortless. Whether for work or daily driving, OEDRO floor mats provide reliable protection that keeps your truck interior looking clean, sharp, and well-maintained.
Features
Custom Fitment design: Designed specifically for 2022–2026 Nissan Frontier Crew Cab models with 2nd row under-seat storage, ensuring precise edge-to-edge coverage and secure placement.
All-Weather Protection: Built from strong, flexible rubber-like TPE material, these mats withstand daily wear, heavy foot traffic, and extreme weather conditions without cracking or deforming.
Waterproof & Easy to Clean: Raised edge design effectively traps water, mud, sand, and spills. Simply rinse with water or wipe clean—no lingering stains or odors after drying.
Anti-Slip Secure Grip Design: Engineered with a textured bottom surface to keep the mats firmly in place, preventing unwanted movement while driving for enhanced safety and comfort.
Enhanced Interior Appearance: Adds a clean, rugged, and premium look to your truck interior while providing full carpet protection, helping maintain resale value over time.
2 years warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
